notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.8 released 20 Aug 2025
notes.content:
Added options under Settings so the player can choose whether gains and losses summaries should be displayed after undertakings and phase endings.

Added more hints to the hint system.

Improved instructions and feedback during lockpick mini-game.

Shelter tools window will now close when switching tabs while it is open (It could get in the way when switching to daily planning, leaving a new player confused as to how to leave the shelter).

You can now close notification messages with the ESC key. You can still close them by clicking on the trash can.

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.7 released 19 Jul 2025
notes.content:
It will now be indicated properly on the weapon selector bar when a broken weapon is equipped.
Added more hints to the hint system.
Fixed a bug where an npc crook running away would unintentionally attract rats or bats meant for another npc.

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.6 released 15 Jul 2025
notes.content:
Added a hint system which displays gameplay hints during loading transitions. 

Added difficulty settings. A player can now choose between an Easy, Normal and Hard game when starting a new game.

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.5 released 13 Jul 2025
notes.content:
Ultrawide screen support added. Players with ultrawide resolution screens can now play the game without having to force HD resolution via launch options.

Tweaked courage and morale gain for killing enemies. The hero will now gain courage faster when killing enemies and also gain a bit of morale for every kill.

Increased the condition gained for a tool when someone with sharpening skill sharpens a tool.
